full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media monochrome image shows an imposing man's face cropped close against an off-white, scuffed surface. The top of the head is cut by the frame, and the cheeks extend nearly to both side edges. Broad black smears swallow the eyes, leaving only faint traces of eyelids within the shadow. The central nose catches gray-white light, its bridge and tip emerging as rough sculptural planes. Below, a heavy dark mustache covers the upper lip, and a short pale cylinder sits at the center of the mouth. The lower lip, chin, and right cheek break into grainy gray patches and hard black cuts. At the bottom, a dark coat, white shirt collar, and black tie provide a few recognizable clothing shapes beneath the otherwise fragmented head. The background remains warm white rather than clean digital white, crossed by pencil-like construction marks, vertical drips, stains, scratches, and torn-paper-looking interruptions. Along the right side of the face, scraped layers expose different gray densities, making the portrait feel partially erased and reconstructed. Light is frontal but uneven, bleaching the forehead, nose, and collar while the sockets and jaw sink into ink-black shadow. The image combines photographic facial volume with charcoal-like abrasion and collage texture; edges alternate between sharply cut dark patches and dissipating powdery marks. There is no readable text. The overall composition is confrontational and unstable, using harsh monochrome contrast and distressed surface marks to make one close face feel both tangible and elusive.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介单色画面呈现一张迫近观者的男子面孔，背后是灰白、擦损的表面。头顶被画框切去，双颊几乎延伸到左右两边。宽阔黑色擦痕吞没双眼，只在阴影中留下隐约眼睑痕迹。中央鼻子接住灰白光，鼻梁与鼻尖以粗糙雕塑般平面浮现。下方厚重深色胡须盖住上唇，一截浅色短圆柱停在嘴部中央。下唇、下巴和右脸颊碎成颗粒状灰块与坚硬黑色切面。底部，深外套、白衬衫领口和黑领带在破碎头部下方提供少数可辨的衣物形态。背景是暖灰白，而非干净数字白，穿过铅笔般结构线、竖向滴痕、污渍、刮线和似撕纸的断裂。脸部右侧，刮去的层次露出不同深浅的灰色，让肖像像被部分抹除后重新拼合。光线来自正面却不均匀，使额头、鼻梁和衣领泛白，眼窝与下颌沉入墨黑。画面把摄影式面部体积与炭笔般磨损、拼贴肌理结合；边缘从锐利切出的暗块变化到散开的粉状笔迹。没有可读文字。整体构图直逼观者且不稳定，以严厉的单色对比和受损表面痕迹，让近距离面孔既可触又难以捕捉。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media monochrome treatment fuses photographic tonal volume with charcoal abrasion, scraped layers, drips, and paper-like scuffs. Warm off-white, ash gray, and near-black form an extreme but varied value range. Dark areas gather in broad opaque masks, while pale planes are interrupted by faint construction lines and powdery texture. Selective hard edges collide with dissolving rubbed marks, preventing any fully polished finish. Uneven frontal illumination isolates a few bright structural planes and leaves adjacent recesses nearly black. Tight cropping makes the central mass feel immediate, and vertical streaks add a distressed downward rhythm. The overall effect is raw, psychologically charged, and tactile, with erasure as important as drawn detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介单色处理把摄影式明度体积与炭笔磨擦、刮开的层次、滴痕和纸面般擦损融合。暖灰白、灰烬色与近黑构成极端却丰富的灰阶。深色聚成宽阔不透明遮蔽块，浅色平面则被隐约结构线和粉状肌理打断。选择性的硬边与逐渐消失的擦痕碰撞，避免任何彻底抛光的完成感。不均匀正面照明隔离少数明亮结构平面，让邻近凹处近乎黑色。紧密裁切使中央体块直接逼近观者，竖向流痕又添入受损的下坠节奏。整体效果原始、心理张力强且有触感，抹除与描画细节同样重要。
theme_en: A close black-and-white face with eyes swallowed by shadow
theme_zh: 双眼没入阴影的黑白近景面孔
name: Richard Hambleton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
